# Intersection of Two Arrays. compare: unordered 0 accepts any order; the
# expected answers below list the values in increasing order.

@example 3 and 11 occur in both arrays, so they are the answer; nums1 repeats 3, but it is listed once.
[3,8,11,3]
[11,5,3]
=> [3,11]

@example 6 and 0 are repeated in both arrays and still listed once each; 2 is only in nums1.
[6,0,6,2,0]
[0,6,6,6]
=> [0,6]

@example No value occurs in both arrays.
[2,5,8]
[1,3,6,7]
=> []

=> [1,3,8]

[2,4]
[1,2,3,4,5]
=> [2,4]

[10,20,30,40]
[30,10,30]
=> [10,30]

[1,7]
